title: How do I edit a tileset to be 8 tiles wide?

posts.author: AOZero2
posts.body: I have an entire tileset custom made I paid for. How do I edit it to be 8 tiles wide so I can use it in XP? I imported it but anything beyond 8 tiles wide is cutoff.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
If the artist made an exclusive for another edition of RPG Maker, I don't know if he can use it in RMXP for a commercial project.
If the assets are not specific to the engine, just use the Tileset TEMPLATE:
Each RMXP tile is 32x32 pixels, just resize the graphics to fit, but if the value is not a multiple, the graphics will probably be distorted.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
AOZero2 said:
I imported it but anything beyond 8 tiles wide is cutoff.
Click to expand...
basically open it in an image program that supports transparency and layers (GIMP, Photoshop or similar).
then cut away any tiles that are beyond the 8 tile limit and re-attach them below the existing tiles.
you'll need to increase canvas size vertical to get space for that, and reduce horizontal canvas size to fit the 8 tile limit.
EDIT: and next time, give the artist the maker definitions before he starts working
